gate_decision.rationale: Active runtime leakage has been successfully halted across public Git, Pages, Actions Artifacts, and write pipelines (four negative proofs verified). However, Gate A4 remains strictly FAIL because: (1) real-session tests for entitled, denied, expired, and revoked reads remain NOT_TESTED due to the absence of dedicated non-production test accounts; (2) historical Git commits retain disclosed allocations as documented residual exposure; and (3) retired legacy cn_x1_2 row requires owner-governed decommission.

surface_1_public_git.target: Current tracked files in public main
surface_1_public_git.findings: Active runtime signal ledgers removed from git tracking; fresh hydration is git-ignored (.gitignore); 16 anonymous Raw/Contents requests to active latest endpoints return 404.

surface_2_historical_git.target: Historical commit trees prior to cutover
surface_2_historical_git.findings: Historical commits on main contain disclosed weights; per ADR-0004, history is not rewritten retrospectively to preserve cryptographic immutability.

surface_3_pages.findings: sync-formal-model-runs.mjs produces public_historical_projection_v1 with zero operating_state, zero current_weights, zero target_weights; verified on live Pages deployment.

surface_4_actions_artifacts.findings: Daily producer alerts upload only verified metadata receipts (result.json); Formal run 41083709573 uploaded only archive-bindings and publication observation with zero operational keys.

surface_5_write_pipelines.findings: All 4 producer workflows (QQQ, BYD, US Ranker, CN27) and Formal refresh transactions write exclusively to private CAS archive (archives/strategy-signal-ledgers/latest.zip) via authenticated SSH with CAS conflict detection; public git commits completely removed.

protected_row_denial.reason: No non-public strategy access policy is currently declared in production configuration; cannot test unauthorized rejection without introducing dummy test rows or altering production tiers.

entitled_denied_revoked_real_sessions.reason: Single-operator workstation environment lacks dedicated testing accounts/sessions.

owner_action_items: Formally acknowledge and accept historical Git disclosure as residual risk per ADR-0004.
Authorize retirement of legacy cn_x1_2 row from current operations runtime.
Provide dedicated test credentials if formal entitled/denied/revoked automated session test is required prior to v1 release signoff.
